notes: This source/test traceability contract covers only Umbra's read-only Is Attribute Owned By Federate path in the non-installable IEEE 1516.1-2025 development profile. It uses only candidate records exported by the Requirements Lab and does not infer missing IDs. The implementation validates the requesting federate's known instance and known-class attribute, then returns whether that same joined federate is the current owner; for an RTI-owned joined-federate MOM attribute it returns false without changing state. It does not induce a callback or change ownership. Ownership acquisition/divestiture, resign-action ownership disposition, timestamped/retraction behavior, DDM, FOM sharing policy, save/restore, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice. The linked Catch2 tests demonstrate bounded implementation slices, not full IEEE 1516.1-2025 conformance.
